description: A free, open-source AI agent that runs entirely on your machine — controls your computer like you would, works across any app, and handles arbitrary tasks: writing code, analyzing images, organizing files, researching and building spreadsheets, whatever you throw at it. Unlike Claude Cowork, nothing leaves your device.
